audit-event.name: Audit Event
audit-event.purpose: Represent one traceable event with actor/action label, description, metadata, timestamp, and visible status without becoming a timeline, audit table, approval process, or investigation workflow.

anatomy.rule: Identifies the event type without replacing text.
Names actor/action/result in compact readable hierarchy.
Shows actor, source, or audit context as supporting information.
Shows time as visible mono metadata when required.
Shows status with text and semantic tone, never color alone.
Provides local row framing without owning list sequencing.

audit-event.statePrecedence: disabled > critical > warning > verified > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy so Audit Event remains a bounded component.
Energy.behavior: Audit Event exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Energy.rejectIf: Timelines, audit tables, approval flows, and investigation processs belong to patterns.

do: Use Audit Event for its bounded job.
dont: Timelines, audit tables, approval flows, and investigation processs belong to patterns.
Do not create multi-step system inside it.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: documentation preview only; do not use Audit Event as a mobile history pattern
dense admin side panel or audit-adjacent record

agentInstructions: Use Audit Event only for one atomic event.
Use tone and state for local status; do not invent business variants.
Escalate ordered histories, connectors, filters, approvals, and investigations to patterns.
rejectIf: The component becomes a timeline, audit table, approval flow, or investigation workflow.
Docs render a non-package audit event instance.
